diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.panel.title: Troubleshoot and share
diagnostics.panel.description: Run one health check, review what actually needs attention, and only then use fixes or support exports.
diagnostics.fixes.title: Suggested fixes
diagnostics.fixes.description: Only actions that match the current health check are shown here.
diagnostics.fixes.empty-description: Run health check first so FolderView Plus can suggest the right repair path.
diagnostics.summary.empty-title: Run health check to inspect the plugin state.
diagnostics.summary.empty-description: The summary will call out Docker, VM, storage, icon, and update issues without dumping raw JSON first.
diagnostics.support.title: Share with support
diagnostics.support.description: Use the issue report for quick triage and the support bundle when someone needs the full picture.
diagnostics.support.note: Support bundle exports are sanitized by default and include the troubleshooting data needed for support.
diagnostics.support.preview-description: Included sections and redaction categories will appear here before you download the bundle.
